'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Stephen Kin DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Kin]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name as written on the Day 2 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (Virtual Block 7)|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
